1. **Chart type**  
   - **Thematic choropleth-style map** of the United States, showing regions colored by average “first leaf” appearance month.

2. **Layout techniques**  
   - Uses a **single geographic map layout** (U.S. map).
   - No faceting, no small multiples, no stacking.
   - Regions are differentiated by **filled color areas** over geographic boundaries.
   - Large month names are used as **direct labels** on the map.

3. **Data variables**

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Geographic location (U.S. regions/states) | Categorical / spatial | Position on map (geographic location), boundary outlines |
| Average “First Leaf” appearance month (January, February, March, April, May) | Ordinal / temporal | Color/hue of map regions; direct text labels (“January”–“May”) |
| Date shown (“May 31”) | Temporal | Large text annotation |
| State abbreviations/names | Categorical / nominal | Text labels placed on the map |
